tasks.description: Add a new GET endpoint /api/urls/{shortCode}/status to the existing URL API. Return HTTP 200 with JSON fields shortCode (string) and expired (boolean). An unset or future expiration means expired=false; a past expiration means true. Unknown codes must return HTTP 404. Reading status must never increment clicks. Add public java.util.Map<String,Object> getStatus(String shortCode) to UrlService using a read-only transaction, the existing repository lookup, existing 404 behavior, and Instant.now() to evaluate expiration. Add the annotated controller endpoint to UrlController, delegating to urlService.getStatus(shortCode). Preserve existing endpoints and behavior.
